Dominik Szoboszlai in the Bundesliga was unreal
A Hungarian international, a world-class midfielder and one of the finest shooters the league has ever seen. Dominik Szoboszlai ticks all these boxes. The Hungarian played for RB Leipzig in the Bundesliga from 2021 to 2023, where he established himself as a world-class footballer before moving to Liverpool. This clip shows you his Bundesliga highlights. Which one was your favorite? Let us know in the comments!
